title: 逆転裁判
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

The table: the whole font (1,351 characters) read off numbered sheets of the cartridge's glyphs in code order (`yomikata rom-font`). The 276 read in play before, in sentences, all agree with the sheets, and 16 more stood right in 14 pages played after; the other 1,059 were read once, by one reader. No second reader has read it
Played from power-on through the first episode's opening. What the script said in play agreed with the rows read off 61 of 61 pictures, over 4 scenes. No screen without text was among them
The same readings built the table, so the comparison checks pages and their order more than it checks the characters
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-ASBJ.lua. A scene's script lies unpacked in the 256 KB on the board; a word in the CPU's 32 KB says where it has got to. A page is said when that stands on a wait. The table has the whole font, 1,351 characters. Who speaks is given as the script's number for the speaker only: the name on the window's tab is a picture. Not looked at: choices, the court record, cross-examination, saved games. The id AGB-ASBJ is the cartridge's code with the console's prefix.
